children: Bitcoin spot ETFs recorded a net inflow of $6.21 million during the trading week of September 14-18, U.S. Eastern Time, according to SoSoValue data. According to Foresight News, BlackRock's IBIT led weekly inflows with $121 million, bringing its cumulative net inflow to $64.12 billion.

Fidelity's FBTC followed with $79.93 million in weekly net inflows and a cumulative net inflow of $10.36 billion. Ark & 21 Shares' ARKB saw the largest weekly outflow at $142 million, while its cumulative net inflow stood at $1.08 billion.

As of press time, Bitcoin spot ETFs held total net assets of $102.53 billion, with an ETF net asset ratio of 6.29% of Bitcoin's total market value. Cumulative net inflows across the products reached $55.16 billion.

title: Bitcoin Spot ETFs Record $6.21 Million Net Inflow in Week of September 14-18
